text.title: AI Overview Presence Tracker Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the 8-week AI Overview presence report: a versioned query set of at least 20 queries mapped to target URLs on the tracked domain, one fixed scrape configuration (country, language, device, logged out), per-query weekly rows typed as `aio_present` / `citations` / `our_domain_cited` / `selected_snippet` / `panel_position` with failed scrapes recorded as missing, `metrics[]` with the stated denominators (presence over observed queries, citation over present panels, median position over present panels) per week and for the window, findings that state co-occurrence only, and a retrofit list gated on 5-of-8 presence and 4 uncited weeks ranked by impressions. Validator at scripts/validate-ai-overview-presence-tracker.py enforces it, including the host match, the denominators and the retrofit gate.

required.field: one query-set version per 8-week window; adding or removing queries starts a new version (r-fixed-versioned-query-set)
the registrable domain a citation must match, plus subdomains explicitly listed (r-our-domain-cited-exact-host-match)
`adapter`, `country`, `language`, `device` (mobile or desktop), `logged_out: true`, `aio_available_checked: true`, fixed for the window (r-fixed-locale-device-logged-out)
at least 20, each `query` with one `target_url` on the tracked domain (r-fixed-versioned-query-set)

one per query per week: `query`, `week` 1-8, `observed_at`, `status` observed or missing, `aio_present`, `citations[]`, `our_domain_cited`, `selected_snippet`, `panel_position`; a present panel has at least one citation and a position; an absent panel has none; a missing week has nulls (r-per-query-row-fields, r-weekly-same-day-no-interpolation)
`aio_presence_rate`, `our_citation_rate`, `median_panel_position` for each week and for the window, each with `numerator`, `denominator` and `unit` (r-report-metrics-presence-citation-position)
each names a `metric`, has `co_occurrence_only: true` and `causal: false`; no click or impression change is attributed to the panel (r-no-click-attribution-to-aio)
entries only for queries present in at least 5 of 8 weeks and uncited in each of the last 4, ranked by `impressions` descending, each with `target_url` and `cited_domains` (r-retrofit-priority-rule)

forbidden.pattern: fewer than 20 queries, or rows from two `query_set_version` values in one report — query-set-drifts-mid-window
a row with `status: observed`, `aio_present: true` and empty `citations`, or a failed scrape written as `aio_present: false` — scrape-failure-logged-as-absence
`scrape_config.device` outside mobile / desktop, `logged_out: false`, or a config that changed inside the window — locale-or-device-switch
`our_domain_cited: true` with no citation URL whose host is the tracked domain or a listed subdomain — brand-mention-counted-as-citation
a finding with `causal: true`, or text attributing clicks or impressions to the panel ("cost us", "because of", "led to") — clicks-attributed-to-aio
a retrofit entry with `weeks_present` below 5, or whose last 4 rows include `our_domain_cited: true` — retrofit-on-unstable-panel
`our_citation_rate` with the observed-query count as denominator, or a rate outside 0..1 — r-report-metrics-presence-citation-position
an `observed_at` more than 2 days from the week's scheduled day, or a missing week filled with values — r-weekly-same-day-no-interpolation

list.item: At least 20 queries, each with a `target_url` on `tracked_domain`, under one `query_set_version` for the whole window (r-fixed-versioned-query-set).
Every row is typed; a present panel carries citations and a position, an absent one carries none, a failed scrape is `status: missing` with nulls (r-per-query-row-fields).
`scrape_config` is one country, language, device and a logged-out session for every row, and AIO availability was checked first (r-fixed-locale-device-logged-out).
Each row's `observed_at` is within 2 days of `window_start` + 7 x (week - 1); missing weeks reduce the denominator instead of being filled (r-weekly-same-day-no-interpolation).
`our_domain_cited` is true only when a citation URL's host is `tracked_domain` or a listed subdomain (r-our-domain-cited-exact-host-match).

`aio_presence_rate` = present / observed, `our_citation_rate` = cited / present, `median_panel_position` over present panels, per week and for the window, all recomputable from the rows (r-report-metrics-presence-citation-position).
Every finding names a metric, states co-occurrence only, and makes no causal click claim (r-no-click-attribution-to-aio).
Every retrofit entry has 5-of-8 presence and 4 uncited trailing weeks in the rows, names the target URL and the domains cited, and the list is ranked by impressions (r-retrofit-priority-rule).
